title: When the Summit Breaks
author: Ansel Oyelaran
blurb: Mara Yarrow, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
